name: Our Lady of Mount Carmel and St Joseph, Salford
shortName: Our Lady of Mount Carmel and Saint Joseph

boundary.description: From the junction of University Road and Wallness Lane, by a straight line E to River Irwell. Then along the River Irwelland Manchester Ship Canal to the point opposite the footpath near SIS Live Teleport (Media City UK), then by a bee-line NE to and E along Broadway, to the point opposite Olympic Court. By a bee-line N to and along Olympic Court, Montford Street, West Ashton Street, Eccles New Road, to the point opposite Cyprus Close. By a bee-line N to and E along the railway to the roundabout joining M602 and Albion Way (A5063). N by Albion Way and Salford Crescent – Swinton railway and by a beeline NE to the University Road and its junction with Wallness Lane.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St John the Evangelist and St Joseph, Ordsall
internalBoundaries.description: Along the railway from railway bridge on river Irwell to to the roundabout joining M602 and Albion Way (A5063).
